snippet.title: Touhou Astronomical Few Minute - Lunatic 1cc (Utsuho)
snippet.description:
Update: I added subtitles to explain some stuff (which you can also read in the description)
Update²: Apparently which stage 2 you get might depend on the eclipse gauge and is not random at all

Oh boy, this game.

It's been nearly 2 years since I uploaded my 1cc of RoHL, so it was time to get a clear of the successor of that iconic wonderful game ...

It's not that much better.

00:00 Stage 1A
02:58 Stage 2C
07:16 Final A
12:50 ???

Mechanically this game is pretty straightforward: 3 stages, you get lives by collecting point items or extend items and that's it. There's also this weird eclipse going on that's different for both shot types but I honestly don't know what it does and I don't know where to look for information on that. Oh welp.

What makes this game unique is not only having Utsuho and Eirin as the playable shot types, but also having unique stages: stage 1 and stage 3 both depend on the chosen shot type.
-And then there's stage 2 ... which is mostly the same but there are actually 3 different stage 2s and IT IS RANDOM which you will get. You always want to have 2C with Alice since she's the easiest fight. The other two are Sakuya/Remi for 2A and Medicine for 2B. Yes, it's as horrible as it sounds.-

So yeah, this game is not good. It feels as funky as RoHL, the balance is off, stages are pretty bland and of course there are some really bad bugs. Replays will probably always desync, e.g. when I tried to watch this one, it started in Eirin's first stage and I was even able to bomb manually DURING THE REPLAY. It's quite an experience.
At least it has a banging soundtrack.

Sadly since I'm apparently not trustworthy enough for YT I can't add any links right now to this description, so if you're interested in this game for some reason, well, you're on your own (there is no page on the Touhou wiki for this anyways lol)
